svg.title: 07 · End-to-End Payment Transaction Flow (P2P transfer)
svg.desc: Sequence diagram of a P2P transfer: party lookup via ALS and the MSISDN oracle, quote via the quoting service, and transfer via the ML API adapter, Kafka, central-ledger handlers and MySQL, with callbacks to both FSPs, correlation identifiers, states and verified error scenarios.
svg.text: Discovery → agreement → transfer, traced through the services, Kafka topics, ledger states and callbacks (verified in the 2026-11-04 labs)
Customer asks to pay 100 to MSISDN 17039811904
FSP authenticates the customer (login, PIN), screens AML/fraud and creates an idempotency key. None of this
